title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East (Late Show) on 1968-06-14
source: Source: Audience Cassette Master > Reel > pcm (sony HG tape) provided by Tim Dalton; Transfer: ocm > Sony SL-10 > Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 > WAV 16/44.1 - Transferred By Charlie Miller; Lineage: wav > iZotope RX6 Advanced > iZotope 5 Advanced > CD Wave > TLH > Flac 16; edited and mastered SIRMick February 2018

ai_review.summary: Historic Fillmore East audience tape with decent but imperfect sound captures a smoking St. Stephen and a wild Caution, though vocal clarity suffers.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience (AUD) source that benefits from recent EQ and balance work, yet the vocals remain a bit muddy and some distortion remains, especially on the early Dark Star segment. Musically the show shines – the early “St. Stephen” is described as insane, the eleven‑minute “The Eleven” flows organically, and Caution (with Pig’s harp) delivers powerful moments, making this a high‑energy performance despite missing pieces.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the historic set and highlight performances (average rating ~4), but one reviewer rates it 0 due to recording flaws, pulling the overall weighted average down; thus a solid middle‑high score with medium confidence from four reviews.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Improved balance and EQ fixes noted, but vocals lack crispness, some distortion remains, and the early Dark Star side is missing, leading to an overall decent but imperfect sound.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Unusual ordering with Lovelight sandwiched between Alligator and Caution, creating a unique suite; the transition from Feedback into The Eleven is praised for its organic flow.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pig's harp work during the Caution reprise is highlighted as strong and not slack.
